USED CAR GUYS — APP CONCEPT

A walkthrough of the full customer experience, top to bottom: sign up → browse the lot → pick a car → get matched with a real specialist → track the deal on an animated journey timeline → upload financing documents → and eventually sell a car back. Scroll down to follow the flow in order.
① Sign up, log in, or just start browsing.
② Browse the live inventory, filter and search.
③ Pick a car and see the full detail page.
④ Instantly matched with a real salesperson — a face and a name, not a form.
⑤ The centerpiece: an animated step-by-step timeline of the whole deal, tied to their specialist.
⑥ Upload and track financing documents, right from the phone.
⑦ Down the road: sell the car back in a few taps.
